actions: only tool/library pathname metadata; no GPIO tools executed
command:
set -eu
echo TOOL_CHECK_START; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
for n in gpiodetect gpioinfo gpioget gpiomon; do echo "$n"; command -v "$n" || true; done
echo LIBRARY_METADATA
for p in /usr/lib/libgpiod.so* /lib/libgpiod.so* /usr/bin/gpio* /bin/gpio*; do test -e "$p" || continue; stat -c '%n %s %u:%g:%a' "$p"; done
echo TOOL_CHECK_END; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
